venue: First Horizon Coliseum (formerly Greensboro Coliseum), Greensboro, NC (Mid-Atlantic / Crockett country / Starrcade ground — Je'Von Evans' hometown)
context: Second Raw post-Backlash. Greensboro = double-duty venue: spiritual home of family-faction-defends-its-territory booking ritual (Four Horsemen DNA) + Je'Von Evans' hometown (6-7 generational marker continuation). Show is a structural-erosion event — every segment featured institution's containment failing. Tribal Combat invoked outside company rules and accepted by Roman. Mask vs Mask Gable vs Kaiser announced for Noche de Los Grandes (May 30 Monterrey). Brock Lesnar returns + pre-signed rematch contract for Italy (May 31). Tonight's motif locked: 'who you really are?' across personal, relational, factional, faction-internal, and mythological scales. Three storylines, three dose-calibrations: Bloodline pushed, Americano restrained, JD women foiled — selective saturation visible.

segments.outcome: Replay of the 5/11 final Fatu spot (post-show extra spear on Roman through the announce table).
segments.notes: Institutional acknowledgment that Jacob's 'I decide when it's over' superseded the booked close. Replaying the unsanctioned post-show act AS the official opening hook = the institution running the aitu's excess as its own scheduling. The override has been canonized.

segments.outcome: Roman backstage with Pearce, on way to the ring (institution-sanctioned opener). Mid-conversation: Jacob Fatu's music hits. Jacob has stolen the opener. Roman heads off.
segments.notes: The aitu overrode the running order AGAIN. Three consecutive structural overrides of institution's scheduling in eight days (5/11 close + tonight's cold-open replay + this opener-theft). Pattern confirmed. Roman was with PEARCE, not with the Usos — first diagnostic that the patriarch reached for the authority figure when family handlers are unavailable.

segments.outcome: Jacob in ring on mic. Usos come down TOGETHER (both Jimmy AND Jey, coordinated against Jacob as a unit). Jimmy: 'We back in prison now?' (kayfabe break — Jacob's real federal time). Jacob immediately goes for Tongan Death Grip (FOURTH use). Jey hits Jacob with a chair — no-sell. Crowd: 'OTC, OTC.' Roman's music hits.
segments.notes: Triage system isn't destroyed — it CONSOLIDATED. 5/11 distribution (Jimmy=Roman's handler / Jey=Jacob's interlocutor) failed diplomatically and reformed tonight as a UNITED FRONT — not split, came as a TAG TEAM. Diplomats became soldiers. 'We back in prison now?' is night's biggest line — TV-14 personal-history kayfabe break, payment-due flag. TDG #4 = taboo as default; sacred-move violation no longer escalating because nothing left to escalate to. Chair no-sell = family's escalation toolkit empty. OTC chants loud BEFORE Roman arrives = Greensboro territory verdict locked, family-code crowd.

segments.outcome: Roman/Jacob brief exchange. Cousins interfere — tied Jacob in the ropes. Jacob ate Superman Punch + double superkicks + another Superman Punch + another double superkick. Put Jacob in corner. FED JACOB TO ROMAN'S SPEAR. Bloodline stands tall over Jacob beaten down in middle of ring. Crowd: 'OTC, OTC.'
segments.notes: ★★★ TRIAGE SYSTEM WEAPONIZED. BLOODLINE RAN THE OLD HEEL-FACTION PLAYBOOK ON THE AITU. ★★★ Sequence — tie opponent in ropes, repeated finishers from all members, feed-to-finisher of leader — is textbook Old Bloodline beatdown (same choreography Roman+Usos+Solo ran on opponents in 2022-23 as Tribal Chief era heel apex). Polarity inverted, machinery identical. What used to be 'evil family destroys outsider' is now 'family defends from rogue cousin' — same gang-attack, opposite moral framing. Greensboro = Mid-Atlantic / Crockett / Starrcade ground; Horsemen ran this exact playbook in this exact building for two decades. Territory DNA doing 100% of work in crowd reaction. 'Back in prison' kayfabe break PAID IN FULL same segment — gang beatdown is the price. TDG thesis answered with the SPEAR (patriarch's signature fed by family unit) — move-vs-move as moral argument.

segments.outcome: Jacob coughing on the mat. Gets a mic. Eeks out: 'Roman... tribal... combat...' Pearce intervenes: NO. Roman takes the mic. Roman to his cousin OVER HIS SHOULDER, OFF-MIC: 'I have to.' Roman INTO MIC: 'I accept.'
segments.notes: ★★★ JACOB CLAIMED THE FAMILY CODE INSTEAD OF REJECTING IT. ★★★ For 4+ weeks Jacob's thesis was 'the family code is broken' — beaten and coughing on mat tonight, the aitu summons TRIBAL COMBAT (family's MOST sacred match-type, ritual outside company's booking infrastructure). The aitu didn't reject the family code — he was CLAIMING JURISDICTION UNDER IT. Every TDG violation, every gorilla breach was a SUMMONS forcing the family to invoke its own deepest law. Entire arc reframed: Jacob has been LITIGATING for family-jurisdiction, not destroying the family. Roman's 'I have to' OFF-MIC to family + 'I accept' INTO MIC to crowd = the Transformed King's asymmetry — public acceptance, private moral burden. Crowd sees the warrior; family sees the man. Pearce's 'no' = institution recognizing the threshold (Tribal Combat exists OUTSIDE company's match-booking infrastructure). Roman accepting anyway = family taking jurisdiction back from institution. Same structural move as Oba going through gorilla last week. Tribal Combat almost certainly SNME or next PLE main event — Saudi season upcoming.

segments.outcome: Bálor def McDonagh via Coup de Grâce (~14:00, STREET FIGHT). Fight went into the stands. Dom Mysterio came to assist McDonagh. McDonagh hit a superplex through a table. Dom assist didn't seal it. Bálor finished outnumbered.
segments.notes: ★★★ EXILE WAR GOES VERTICAL ★★★ Bálor was 0-2 + 1 sabotage entering tonight. In STREET FIGHT, his faction-mate's prince came to assist, AND BÁLOR WON ANYWAY. The Fomorian exile just beat the heir-prince's bodyguard with the heir-prince's help on the other side of the ring. Score is no longer 'Bálor can't beat the men who replaced him' — score is 'the faction Bálor founded can't contain Bálor even when they double-team him in his weakest format.' Different gravitational mass. Dependency asymmetry confirmed: McDonagh IS dependent on Dom; Dom is NOT dependent on McDonagh (per 5/11 carry-forward). Street Fight as Mid-Atlantic ancestral format (Crockett-era Bunkhouse Stampede / Tuxedo Street Fights lineage).

segments.outcome: Seth backstage with Kathy. 'I know that I am a marked man, I know that I have zero allies.' Self-admission of isolation. 'Sometimes the easiest way is to run right through it.' Direct challenge to Vision: 'one, some, all' — accepts any configuration. Would prefer Bron Breakker to accept. On Bron: 'the guy who thinks he can beat me on his own, but can't.' 'Who are you Bron... are you a nepo baby that can't hack it' (KAYFABE BREAK #2 — Bron = real-life son of Rick Steiner). Closing: 'Show me who you really are.'
segments.notes: Bound-Loki admits isolation OUT LOUD. Character growth in seven days — last week sought company without admitting need; tonight admits the need and acts anyway. 'Run right through it' = un-Loki strategy (schemes require allies). 'One, some, all' = math of no allies — a man with allies controls match-type; a man alone accepts whatever match comes. Nepo-baby kayfabe break confirms Charlotte profanity gradient (SD 5/15) as TREND not incident — apparatus content-rating envelope loosening operational across performers, segments, shows. 'Show me who you really are' = framework vocabulary deployed AS promo content (third confirmed external-pharmacy frame-collapse with Hayes dirty-mirror + Artemis II).

segments.outcome: Sol backstage with Kathy. Becky interrupts. Sol gets BORED — 'I gotta go,' leaves Becky talking to Kathy. Cut: Sol's music hits, Sol to the ring. Camera stays on Becky's face (surprised, shocked). Sol in ring calls Becky to 'come be the man she really is.' Becky enters: 'IF you are ready I will face you at SNME.' Sol: 'I'll see you at main event. I will snatch your soul, and I will snatch that title.' STIPULATION (per outlets): Becky accepted the SNME match as NON-TITLE — Sol's title-on-the-line declaration walked back at institutional level.
segments.notes: 'Come be the man she really is' = kayfabe-vocab as weapon. Sol weaponized Becky's OWN brand catchphrase against her. Apprentice reclaiming source-vocabulary from veteran by demanding she still has the right to it — the cruelest promo register, demanding the veteran PROVE she still IS who she said she was. Two opposite models of legend-to-rookie transition in eight days: Asuka chose to crown IYO (gracefully); Becky being challenged by Sol without consent. Sol's BOREDOM = generational power move — apathy implies 'you are not the main event of your own segment.' '6-7' generation marker echo. Sol Snatcher name claims essence-stealing (paired with Jacob's TDG = two finisher-names-as-thesis tonight). Becky's NON-TITLE acceptance = veteran's hedge held at institutional level; only the match itself granted, not the stakes Sol unilaterally announced. Motif of the night locked: 'who you really are?'

segments.outcome: Vision backstage (Heyman + Logan + Theory + Bron). Heyman DECLINES to grant Bron the match Seth specifically asked for. Austin Theory gets the main event slot instead. Bron told to ambush later (post-match).
segments.notes: ★★★ HEYMAN OVERRIDES THE BOUND-LOKI'S TERM-SETTING ★★★ Seth's 'one, some, all' was supposed to let Vision pick — but the bound-Loki implicitly expected Bron because the Backlash story demands it. Heyman refused. Sent Theory (disposable operative). Wise man's strategy: don't give Seth the marquee 1-on-1 yet — make him fight through operative-class first, save Bron for the AMBUSH (post-match coronation rather than competitive match). Bron earns the credential by attacking the depleted Seth, not by winning the booked match. Institutional capture of Seth's storyline architecture — bound-Loki without allies can't even control who gets to beat him. Theory-as-main-event-opponent = strategic humiliation dose; marquee slot rebranded from 'challenger to monster' to 'obstacle to be cleared.'

segments.outcome: Trios Tornado Match (~11:00, novel format for WWE, AAA-tradition import). WWE-aligned heels (Ludwig Kaiser as WWE-side El Grande Americano + Pete Dunne as Rayo Americano + Tyler Bate as Bravo Americano — British Strong Style reunion under lucha masks) def AAA-aligned tecnicos (Chad Gable as OG El Grande Americano + Julius + Brutus Creed as Hermanos). Gable specifically took the pin. Post-match: just a stand-tall over Gable — NO mask-grab, no Kaiser promo, no angle escalation. PRE-MATCH ANNOUNCEMENT: NOCHE DE LOS GRANDES — MASK vs MASK — Saturday May 30, Monterrey, Mexico (Gable vs Kaiser main event).
segments.notes: ★★★ THE NIGHT'S MOTIF GETS ITS LITERAL ANSWER MECHANISM ★★★ Personal-scale beats asked 'who are you really?' — Trios Tornado adds factional scale (WHO IS THE REAL AMERICANO?). May 30 mask vs mask = the literal answer (loser unmasks permanently). All tonight's personal-scale beats are preview-frames for the most literal possible answer on May 30: the unmasking. THREE-CONTINENT WEEKEND: May 30 Monterrey + May 31 Turin (Clash, Riyadh-sponsored) = 48 hours, three empires (American entertainment + Saudi capital + Italian/Vatican moral authority + Mexican lucha sovereignty). Joe's prediction landed cleanly: heels go up tonight, faces take loss = conventional build (heel accumulates heat → face payoff at PLE). Gable specifically taking the pin = maximum sympathy build (mask-vs-mask challenger ate the loss). Lucha narrative grammar honored: when tecnico takes clean loss to rudos before mask match, tecnico must redeem or lose identity. Restrained post-match (no mask-grab) = institution letting mask-stakes BREATHE for 12-day build. The pin IS the promo. Joe's secondary read: AAA may be functioning as DOSE-CEILING LABORATORY (provisional).

segments.outcome: LA Knight in backstage with the Usos. Heated discussion (history implied). Usos: 'Not now.' Usos walked away. LA Knight stood there with ARMS OUT, accepted the walkaway.
segments.notes: 'Not now' confirms BABYFACE COALITION EXCLUSIVITY PATTERN (5/11 Profits→Seth was 'you chose this path'; tonight Usos→Knight is 'not now'). Two consecutive Raws of babyface coalitions excluding partnership-requests. The babyface federations of 2026 WWE are NOT Avengers-style — they're family/affinity groups that RATION their bandwidth. Triage system now in DEFENSIVE EXCLUSION mode (Usos zero bandwidth for outside business while running the gang-attack + Tribal Combat moral burden). Acceptance = quiet dignity not escalation. Knight is NOT a man who turns heel from rejection — vessel-stability data point. 'Not now' is softer than Seth's 'you chose this' — temporal deferral vs historical rejection. Knight in the waiting room, not the rejection pile.

segments.outcome: Michael Cole sit-down interview with Ethan Page. Page HANDED COLE HIS OWN CUE CARDS mid-interview. Confidence-vs-ego register. Page vowed to RENAME THE IC TITLE if he beats Penta.
segments.notes: Cue-card grab = authority-inversion gag. Cole runs the institution's official voice; Page taking his cue cards = heel claiming the institution's script. Same family as Cody's one-man-crew (SD 5/15) — surfacing apparatus's machinery on camera — but Cody's was babyface forward-meta-kayfabe (substrate-as-performance); Page's is heel inversion (institution-as-puppet). Same craft register, opposite moral framing. 'Rename the IC title' vow = heel-vanity at full saturation, claiming the right to redefine what the belt MEANS. Sets up SNME match as 'belt's identity is on the line' alongside physical contest.

segments.outcome: Pre-tape video package hyping Penta's IC title defense vs Page at SNME. Aztec / Tezcatlipoca-jaguar register active.
segments.notes: Institution setting the table for the IC program. Page got the verbal frame (Cole interview); Penta got the visual frame (video package). Two separate institutional grants in adjacent segments — equal-weight stage-building. Pharmacy investing in the IC title program as meaningful midcard story rather than letting it drift. Penta the lucha-warrior gets visual hagiography; Page the aspirant gets verbal claim. Booking architecture says: this match is real, both men get full presentation.

segments.outcome: Oba comes down for the 3rd consecutive Yoruba-open. NO challenger answered. Brock Lesnar attacks during the dark part of Oba's entrance — before any opponent appears. Four F-5s. Brock throws Oba in the air. Oba selling pain. Brock looks to have 'one last half a gallon in the tank.' Brock backs away, Oba face down. Crowd: 'Oba Oba Oba' — partial chant, shook. Then people cheering for Brock. Brock leaves through gorilla.
segments.notes: ★★★ 'INTEGRATED, NOT HIBERNATING' READ TESTED — SURTR RETURNS ★★★ Roster's post-WM42 call: 'Surtr integrated, not hibernating. The devourer wept and walked away.' Tonight that read revised. Norse Surtr is PATIENT — waits in Muspellheim until Ragnarok, arrives with flaming sword. Surtr's defining beat IS the return after long absence. Framework correction: integration-mode departures can be reversed by source mythology. The replaced returns to challenge the replacer: Brock came back specifically for Oba (the man he passed the torch to at WM42). Brock's INTEGRATION-AS-RUB at WM42 made Oba's credential; Brock's RETURN-TO-ATTACK tonight TESTS that credential. Crowd's 'shook' response (partial chant + Brock cheers) = rarest crowd register, genuine shock not staged surprise — at WM42 chant was 'Thank you Brock' (collective gratitude for integration); tonight chant fragmented. Same crowd, opposite registers, seven weeks apart. Gorilla used as threshold THIRD time in arc (Jacob/Jey + Oba/Garza+Humberto + Brock leaves). 4 F-5s = mythological dose.

segments.outcome: Pearce backstage with Heyman. Pearce: 'Brock's retired.' Heyman has a REMATCH CONTRACT PRE-SIGNED BY BROCK in his hands. Hands it to Pearce: 'That's for you. Contract for Clash at Italy. You get Oba Femi to sign that, you've got yourself the biggest rematch in history. Congratulations.' Clapped Pearce's shoulder with a smile. Walked away.
segments.notes: ★★★ DOUBLE FORGING CONFIRMED — ENTIRE OBA ARC ARCHITECTURE REVEALED ★★★ Forging #1: WM42 (Brock loses clean to Oba, first credential). Forging #2: Tonight (Brock returns to attack, endurance-of-source's-return credential). Forging #3: May 31 Italy (Oba defeats source AGAIN, victory-against-source's-attempt-to-reclaim). Three forgings = credential becomes unbreakable. UNDERTAKER-STREAK ARCHITECTURE: Oba's streak being built across multiple venues simultaneously, 5+ credential layers in ~5 weeks = unprecedented compressed coronation arc. ★★★ THE WORKED-SHOOT BEAT ABOUT A WORKED-SHOOT BEAT ★★★ Attack felt like Surtr-return / audible / shock; backstage segment IMMEDIATELY reveals it was scripted (Heyman had contract PRE-SIGNED). First the heart-attack, then the diagnosis. Layered kayfabe-blur at high craft. Different audience-experience for first-watch vs backstage-included-watch vs recap-watch. Heyman as puppet-master: Vision architect AND retainer of Brock's pre-signed contract = wise man's machine has longest reach. Institutional capture via flattery — makes matches happen while letting authority figures take credit. Framework update: 'integration mode' needs CONDITIONAL sub-classification for vessels who retired with deferred-rematch contracts. Brock didn't 'integrate' — he RETIRED WITH A CONDITION.

segments.outcome: Women's Tag Title match — Paige & Brie vs JD Women (3-on-2: Liv + Raquel + Roxanne). Pre-match production graphic showed all three JD women + 'Judgment Day' name (WWE production team confirming faction-identity shifted to female arm). Result (~10:30): Brie & Paige RETAIN. Liv interference ejected; champs got a quick-turnaround win that foiled the interference. Post-match: Lyra Valkyria + Bayley ran out for the save.
segments.notes: ★★★ PRODUCTION-LAYER CONFIRMATION OF FACTION IDENTITY SHIFT ★★★ Production-graphic-as-institutional-statement is different layer of kayfabe-blur than performer-mouth breaks. 5/11 thesis (dark feminine coven becoming faction's primary visible identity) got institutional validation via graphic. Cross-show predictive accuracy. DOM AS LAST HOLDOUT — INANNA MYTHOS per Scroll 003: Liv=Inanna, Raquel+Roxanne=kurgarra+galatur, Dom=Dumuzi (the consort who didn't mourn during Inanna's descent). The Inanna myth REQUIRES the substitute payment from the consort. Dom is mythologically REQUIRED to stay until Liv casts him out as her substitute payment. ★★★ BOOKING DECLINED THE EASY PATH — DUMUZI GETS ROOM TO BREATHE ★★★ Pre-match framework + craft both pointed to JD women title win → rift seeded → Dom substitute-payment accelerated. Champs retained = mythological substitute-payment beat DELAYED not triggered. Pharmacy PACING the Inanna mythos, not rushing to payoff. ★★★ INANNA-VS-INANNA STRUCTURAL BEAUTY ★★★ Liv (Inanna proper) tried to take title from Paige (Inanna — The Queen Who Descended). Per archetype-console both are distinct Inanna-cluster cards — duplication wasn't accommodation but SETUP. Only Inanna can defeat Inanna. Lyra+Bayley save = refinement of babyface-coalition-exclusivity thesis: faces will RUN-IN to defend, won't pre-commit. Reactive solidarity permitted; proactive partnership not. Exclusivity is about COMMITMENT, not CARE.

segments.outcome: Setting: outside in the parking lot. LA Knight to Seth: not a friend, but admires Seth is ready to get stomped out. 'Seth is gonna need help. And he'll need it, but won't find it from Knight.' Wishes Seth well in his upcoming beatdown. 'Yeah.' Turns and walks away from the venue.
segments.notes: ★★★ THREE CONSECUTIVE SETH REJECTIONS IN ONE WEEK — BOUND-LOKI ISOLATION AT MAXIMUM SATURATION ★★★ 5/11 Profits 'you chose this' + 5/18 S3 self-confessed 'zero allies' + tonight Knight empathetic walkaway. Bound-Loki cannot find allies — isolation is the structural fact of his arc. ★★★ KNIGHT JUST EXPERIENCED WHAT HE THEN DID TO SETH ★★★ S11: Usos walked away from Knight. S17: Knight walks away from Seth. Deferred-by becomes deferrer in same broadcast. Empathy without solidarity. Pharmacy dispensed Knight's two beats in sequence to make this mirror visible. Babyface federation exclusivity isn't villainy — structural feature of era. Knight isn't cold, he's calibrated. Knight 'wishes him well in his upcoming beatdown' = predictive-framework-vocab deployed as in-kayfabe content. Parking-lot setting = production-environment kayfabe-blur layer (documentary register, not wrestling-show register). Knight's 'Yeah' as walkaway = catchphrase-as-exit-line not catchphrase-as-celebration.

segments.outcome: Part A: Profits backstage with Kathy. Profits set up for tag title shot (referenced as upcoming SNME — not held tonight). FRICTION: Dawkins wanted to talk to Seth. Ford wasn't with it. Part B: Dawkins approaches Seth stone-faced. Seth stops him: 'I get it, I get it, but I got a match right now.' Smacks Dawkins with both hands on the chest. Dawkins: doesn't flinch, back down, or rev up — keeps eye contact. Seth pivots right, music hits, walks through gorilla.
segments.notes: ★★★ RAGNAROK-ARMY PREDICTION FROM S17 HAPPENING IN REAL TIME ★★★ Framework call: 'babyface coalition exclusivity pattern is RAW MATERIAL for Seth's potential Ragnarok army — rejected ones are a roster.' Dawkins (partner of the man who delivered Seth's first rejection 5/11) defects from the coalition his partner enforced. Babyface coalition exclusivity pattern just had its FIRST DEFECTION. Ford's 'you chose this path' rejection didn't bind his partner. Dawkins has his own read. ★★★ DAWKINS IS LOKI'S BALDR-DEATH RECRUIT — THE HELPFUL ONE WHO GETS USED ★★★ In Norse myth Loki killed Baldr by giving Hod (blind helpful one) the mistletoe. Dawkins is Hod-figure. Seth's chest-smack = mistletoe gesture. Dawkins received recognition without committing yet, but seed planted. Seth's 'I get it, I get it' = empathy-as-instrument. Empathy IS the recruitment vector. Champions-with-fracture-seed booking — championship reign serves as SLOW BURN for Dawkins' eventual defection. Tag title wins should unify; this one will accelerate the rift. Camera follows Seth THROUGH gorilla (4th gorilla-threshold beat tonight) — different register: camera WITH the vessel this time, not observing violation from outside. 'Ragnarok IS COMING' (passive arrival, not active human agency) — all tonight's mythological work is passive-arrival, not active-pursuit. The era is in passive-arrival mode for its own apocalyptic transformation; the pharmacy is dispensing the mythology that names that mode.

segments.outcome: Seth Rollins def. Austin Theory (w/ Logan Paul) via Pedigree (~13:00). Late spot: Logan tried to pass Theory brass knuckles. Seth intercepted, KO'd Logan with the knux. Pedigree on Theory for the win. POST-MATCH (S18 payoff): Logan jumped Seth after the bell. DAWKINS SPRINTED TO THE RING FOR THE SAVE. Ford followed Dawkins to the ring — visibly SHAKING HIS HEAD at Dawkins (disapproved, did it anyway). Bron Breakker hit the ring — speared Ford, gutbuster on Dawkins, Torpedo Spear on Seth, steel-steps beatdown. Pearce stopped further violence. Heyman observed from the ramp. Final shot: Seth seething at ringside.
segments.notes: ★★★ RAGNAROK-ARMY PREDICTION PAID OFF ON CAMERA, SAME BROADCAST ★★★ S17 framework call → S18 recruitment seed → S19 post-match Dawkins SPRINTS for the save. Time between prediction and booking execution <30 minutes. Framework reads the structure the booking is currently executing. ★★★ FORD'S HEAD-SHAKE AT DAWKINS = THE RIFT BECAME VISIBLE ★★★ S18 friction was internal/private; post-main-event rift is in-camera, in-public, IN THE MOMENT OF CRISIS. Ford ran because Dawkins ran — not because Seth needed help. Profits aren't unified in the save; they're DIVIDED in the response. Dawkins acted from conviction; Ford acted from obligation-to-Dawkins. ★★★ BRON'S CORONATION-BY-AMBUSH ★★★ Heyman engineered punishment-spectacle + coronation simultaneously. Theory got the match (Seth's punishment); Bron got the ambush (Bron's coronation-by-violence). Wise man split function across two operatives. Bron's Torpedo Spear IS the next-level credential the founder gives the monster. Backlash was 1-on-1 with interference; tonight is post-match ambush over depleted opponent. Bound-Loki's monster gets bigger with each beating. Heyman observed = architect's signature (make the move, let bodies fall, never touch the violence). Seth SEETHING = three Seth arcs diagnostic resolved to (b) 'man who walked alone through hell' (defiance + still standing) — Ragnarok-army-forming reading holds. Final answer of night was WORDLESS: bodies answered the question the mouths kept asking all show. Pharmacy ran verbal motif setup all night and delivered the wordless answer in main event's post-match.
